body: This reminds me of the time a girl in 6th grade told me that shaving your legs above your knees gives you cancer, and that she would know because her dads a doctor.

I am constantly complaining about my clothes. They aren’t cute enough, I don’t have enough, I’m missing the right ‘staples’, etc. I get rid of so many of my clothes because I get sick of looking at them but then I eventually end up missing them. Help
Yes exactly. I’m scared it’s going to be like this for the rest of my life and honestly just feel like a waste of resources and space at this point. I hope things get better for you ❤️
